name: Visa-free entry
summary: Citizens of the EU/UK, Commonwealth countries, the US, and a list of others can enter without a visa. Chinese and Cuban citizens only if the trip is 30 days or less.

other: Need a valid passport (6 months), onward or return ticket, proof of accommodation and funds.
The official list page looks dated (2015/2016 footer). Check it before you travel.

stay.note: Official visa info page says visa-exempt visitors are capped at six months. Officers set the actual stay at the border.

name: Tourist Visa on Arrival
summary: If you normally need a visa, you can get a 30 day single-entry visa at the border when you hold a valid US, Canadian, UK or Schengen visa or residence card. Tourism or visiting friends and family only.

other: Valid US, Canadian, UK or Schengen visa, or a US/Canadian/UK/Schengen residence card.
Passport valid at least 6 months.
Return ticket and enough money for the stay.
Diplomatic and official passports are not eligible.

stay.note: Cannot be extended or converted. A medical visa may be approved if illness requires a longer stay.

name: Entry Visa (eVisa)
summary: Everyone who needs a visa applies online through the official eVisa portal. Multiple-entry visas can be valid 12 or 24 months at the officer's discretion.

other: Required for nationalities not on the visa-exempt list and not eligible for visa on arrival.

steps: Apply online on the eVisa portal.
Scan your documents in color (originals, no photocopies).
Send any extra documents the eVisa Unit asks for within 90 days or the application is rejected.
Keep a digital or printed copy of the eVisa for travel.
documents: Passport bio page, valid at least 6 months from arrival
Recent passport photo, 45mm x 35mm, white background
Proof of travel in and out
Proof of accommodation or invitation letter (students: acceptance letter; business: employer letter)
Bank statements for the previous two months
processing: Not stated on the official page.

name: Resident Permit (Resident Certificate)
summary: Apply after 4 years of legal, ordinary residence, or after 1 year of marriage to an Antiguan citizen. Lets you work and bring approved dependents.

other: At least 4 years legally and ordinarily resident, or married to an Antiguan citizen for at least 1 year.
Did not enter illegally.
Intend to live in Antigua and Barbuda permanently.
No criminal conviction.
The official page does not say if this is permanent residence or a renewable permit. Fee amounts were not available.

documents: Police certificates from Antigua and Barbuda and anywhere lived 6+ months
Letter from statutory boards confirming tax contributions

name: Citizenship by naturalization or marriage
summary: Governed by the Citizenship Act. Residency years, language and test rules were not confirmed from an official page.

other: Not confirmed. See the Citizenship Act (Cap 22) on the immigration site.

name: Citizenship by Investment: National Development Fund
summary: One-time non-refundable contribution of US$230,000 to the National Development Fund. Spouse, dependent children and dependent parents over 55 can be included with no extra contribution.

investment.note: Non-refundable. Pay within 30 days of approval letter.

other: Primary applicant must be over 18.
Applications go through the Citizenship by Investment Unit, with government processing and due diligence fees (amounts are on the Schedule of Fees page, not confirmed here).
Ineligible: false info, serious contagious disease, certain convictions, criminal investigation, security risk, or a visa refusal from a visa-free partner country.

citizenship.note: Citizenship can be revoked if you spend less than 5 days in Antigua and Barbuda in any five-calendar-year period (investment not refunded). Dual citizenship not addressed on the official page.

fees.label: Government processing fee, family of 4 or less
Extra per dependent from the 5th onward

name: Citizenship by Investment: Real Estate
summary: Buy at least US$300,000 of property in an approved project and hold it for at least 5 years.

investment.note: Approved development project, held at least 5 years.

other: Primary applicant must be over 18.

investment.note: Joint option: US$5,000,000 total, min US$400,000 each.
